_about: The app's information architecture, in one file. src/ui/shell.js renders the rail and the phase bar from this and nothing else, so adding a module is a JSON edit. `status` is honest on purpose: 'built' links somewhere real, 'partial' links to the step that half-covers it today, 'planned' renders a stub that says what it will do. Never let a module claim 'built' before it is. A `global` entry may carry `modules` of its own: the Library's reference tools (case studies, dissection, the craft glossary) are tabs of library.html, not steps of a stage, so they hang off the Library rather than off a phase. Their module ids are unchanged, because plans key features by them; src/lib/navmodel.js is the one place that joins the two lists. The Blueprints are NOT a shelf any more: the feature and short blueprints are folded into the five stage pages, each of which mounts a `#guide` section (src/ui/stage-guide.js) rendering that stage's steps, so each stage carries ONE `guide` entry linking to `<stage page>#guide` (`part` is the feature blueprint's Part number). The old feature.html / short.html redirect there (src/pages/blueprint-redirect.js, src/lib/blueprint-route.js). `group` on a module is a sub-heading in its stage's menu (Pre-Production's four). `projectPages: true` on a shelf says its pages write a film, so src/ui/no-project.js gives them the no-project banner as it does a stage's pages. `jobs` is the hub’s three doors: each names the stages it covers and the hub derives its link from the first built module of the first stage listed, so nothing there is a hand-written href. `region` on a MODULE or on a `global` shelf is the market it belongs to — today only 'IN' — and src/lib/navmodel.js drops it everywhere the map is derived when the browser is in International mode (src/lib/region.js). An entry with no `region` belongs everywhere, which is why nothing carries one today: no module here is India-only. The India-specific material is finer-grained than a module — the certification tab of deliverables.html (CBFC, with the COTPA and AWBI rules in src/data/cbfc-rules.json), the Indian OTT delivery templates in deliverables.json, the Chennai rate card, the FEFSI figures and the Indian festival list — and tagging a whole module would hide a page people need in order to hide a tab they do not. A STAGE is never region-tagged: the five stages are the shape of making a film and that shape is the same everywhere.
